trusted_inputs: Future environment-side append-only state/event logger, calibrated instrument receipts and identity/position observations. Self-reported JSON fields alone are not trusted physical evidence.

completion_predicates.requirement: Every required branch exists with nonempty qualified schedule; unknown repeat counts cannot resolve to zero

Guide has fabrication/material/drawing/QC lineage. Each target has either episode manufacturing/release lineage or explicit supplied-part receipt and known preparation provenance, followed by transfer/QC. Do not invent unknown historic jobs.
Mounted guide, source pose, outlet/lining, four distinct flush sensors, channel map, calibrated chain and referenced stage have current receipts
Absent object independently observed for baseline; half-aperture alignment independently observed for the matched control
For every declared valid point: configured source, actual position/frequency, settled acquisition, complete complex channels, consistent identities/calibration/reference and no clipping
All failed attempts retained with unique keys; a valid declared retry never overwrites its failure
Modal/analysis/display products retain exact raw parents and processing versions; interpolation cannot add measured records

Output off and stage stopped if those devices were involved; actually mounted targets safely unloaded/stored, other components accounted for, and station disposition observed. A no-object-only branch needs no fictional target storage. Blocked early work can use scoped abort closure and remains incomplete.

scientific_vs_procedural: Truthful measurements that do not reproduce published peak counts or FWHM can satisfy procedural contracts; their scientific interpretation must report disagreement. Missing evidence never passes merely because a plot matches the paper.
synthetic_validator_scope: tests/record_contract.py exercises narrow record, lineage, calibration, transfer and actor-projection invariants using invented fixtures. It does not implement the complete runtime evaluator or authenticate events. The narrow run validator supports one explicit expanded run at a time and rejects a repeat_count greater than one; campaign repeat expansion remains a future runtime requirement, never a source default.
forbidden_shortcuts: Expected three or five peaks as a success oracle
Reusing source figure pixels as measurements
Treating a rod width as cylinder diameter
Full-disc coverage inferred from a displayed semicircle
Macros that invent missing physical manipulation receipts
